#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    vector<int> l(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        cin >> l[i];
        l[i] %= k;
    }
    if (n == 1) {
        cout << l[0] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    vector<int> l1(l.begin(), l.begin() + n / 2);
    vector<int> l2(l.begin() + n / 2, l.end());

    std::set<int> s, s1;
    std::set<int> s2;

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)l1.size(); i++) {
        for (auto j : s) {
            s2.insert((j + l1[i]) % k);
        }
        s.insert(l1[i]);
        for (auto j : s2) {
            s.insert(j);
        }
        s2.clear();
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < (int)l2.size(); i++) {
        for (auto j : s1) {
            s2.insert((j + l2[i]) % k);
        }
        s1.insert(l2[i]);
        for (auto j : s2) {
            s1.insert(j);
        }
        s2.clear();
    }

    std::vector<int> s_vec(s.begin(), s.end());
    std::vector<int> s1_vec(s1.begin(), s1.end());

    std::sort(s_vec.begin(), s_vec.end());
    std::sort(s1_vec.begin(), s1_vec.end());

    int ans = std::max(*max_element(s_vec.begin(), s_vec.end()), *max_element(s1_vec.begin(), s1_vec.end()));

    auto binarySearchCount = [&](const std::vector<int>& arr, int key) {
        int left = 0, right = (int)arr.size() - 1, count = 0;
        while (left <= right) {
            int mid = (left + right) / 2;
            if (arr[mid] <= key) {
                count = mid + 1;
                left = mid + 1;
            } else {
                right = mid - 1;
            }
        }
        return count;
    };

    for (size_t i = 0; i < s_vec.size(); i++) {
        int t = k - 1 - s_vec[i];
        int ind = binarySearchCount(s1_vec, t);
        int r = (ind > 0) ? s1_vec[ind - 1] : s1_vec[0];
        int rt = s1_vec.back();
        int tmax = ans;
        ans = std::max({(r + s_vec[i]) % k, (s_vec[i] + rt) % k, tmax});
    }

    cout << ans << "\n";

    return 0;
}
